# A2A Protocol 1.0.0 proto

Vendored from the normative A2A 1.0.0 release:

- https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A/blob/v1.0.0/specification/a2a.proto
- Spec: https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/ (Released 1.0.0)

`google/api/*.proto` are the Google API annotation stubs required to load the
official file with `@grpc/proto-loader`. Field numbers match
https://github.com/googleapis/googleapis.

Do not edit `a2a.proto` except to refresh it from the `v1.0.0` tag.
